requirements.text: The system must allow customers to book appointments online, selecting their desired service, barber, and time slot.
It should provide mobile accessibility to accommodate users who prefer to use their devices for bookings.
The system must prevent double bookings to ensure that appointments are managed effectively during busy periods.
Customers should be able to cancel or change their appointments independently without needing to call the barbershop.
The interface must display available services and barber profiles, ensuring it remains user-friendly and not overwhelming for customers.
The new booking system must integrate seamlessly with current workflows without disrupting existing operations.
